column1: # test/langidentity/manifest.tsv -- the fixture corpora test/langidentitycheck.sh runs, one row per directory.
# Columns (TAB-separated): LANG-TAG <TAB> FIXTURE-DIR relative to the repository root, or "-" when the language has none.
# LANG-TAG is the short label of src/model.h (langTag), restricted to the code languages; the gate checks that every
# one of them has at least one row, so a language appended to the enum without a row fails there.
# Pure single-language directories only (a mixed directory would run its other languages' symbols under this tag).
# One exception: test/kotlinfix holds a .java interop file; the top-5 pick filters by extension, so it stays Kotlin.
# Fixture-only languages (no in-sample real repo): java kt swift cs php lua ex clj dart gd objc sh.
# Languages with NO fixture directory: none today. List one as "LANG<TAB>-" here, never leave it out.
